items.summary: Coordinates a virtualized transcript, follow/detach behavior, historical prepend anchors, and stable turn rendering.
useWhen: Rendering a long controlled ChatTurn collection inside one scroll viewport
avoidWhen: Rendering a short static conversation excerpt with no history or follow behavior
sideEffects: Pins focused and disclosed turns in the render window
accessibility: Transcript is a labelled region with an ordered list
History and jump actions are keyboard reachable
examples: Keep scrollTop fixed when a detached transcript receives a new turn
nonExamples: Force the viewport to the bottom after any content resize

items.summary: Binds one protocol-neutral ChatStore to timeline, requests, queue, recovery, and composer blocks.
useWhen: An application adapter implements ChatStore and needs the complete chat surface
avoidWhen: Passing an SDK client, transport event, or provider type directly into UI
actions: all named ChatStore actions and optional application-owned file or child-session callbacks
sideEffects: Routes named user actions to ChatStore
accessibility: Provides stable session and connection metadata
Keeps one primary interactive owner in the bottom region
examples: Mount ChatSession with an application-owned ChatStore
nonExamples: Import provider SDK types into ChatSession props
